steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Fill out a quick form telling us about your store and products. We'll review and confirm your spot within 48 hours.

steps.title: Onboarding
steps.text: We connect to your Shopify store, sync your product catalog, and learn your brand voice. You'll meet your dedicated content strategist.

steps.title: Content Creation
steps.text: Each week, we create and publish blog content tailored to your products. You review drafts before they go live.

steps.title: Results
steps.text: Watch your organic traffic grow. After 3 months, you'll have a library of SEO-optimized content driving visitors to your store.

data.title: Chalet Market
paragraphs: Chalet Market, a Montana-based provider of premium meats and specialty foods, partnered with us to revitalize their Shopify blog. Their online traffic was stagnant despite having high-quality products.

What we did:
  • Weekly blog posts showcasing their unique products
  • Product spotlights with embedded purchase buttons
  • Recipe content featuring their meats and specialty items
  • Storytelling about their Montana rancher partnerships
  • SEO optimization for every post

The results:
  • 105% increase in Shopify store traffic
  • Increased time spent on product pages
  • Holiday-level impressions reached 6 months early

"Content Cucumber's content strategy has made a tangible difference in our online presence. We are seeing increased traffic to our website and Shopify store, and customers are engaging with our brand on a deeper level."
Chalet Market Team
